title: Proper/open interchange for higher images under a proper refinement
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D=(p,a,q,k₀,k) [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and finite-type k₀-schemes. Write C(T) for the existing common-stage constructible Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], I(T) for the category of all Frobenius-equivariant ind-objects of its underlying constructible heart, and y_T:C(T)→I(T) for its specified fully faithful embedding. Inverse image and its chosen adjoints are exactly those normalized by the Yoneda Kan unit in [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. Let j₁:X→Z₁ and j₂:X→Z₂ be open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], let p₁:Z₁→Y and p₂:Z₂→Y be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let r:Z₁→Z₂ be proper with r∘j₁=j₂ and p₂∘r=p₁. For every n∈ℕ and F∈C(X), there is an isomorphism Rⁿp₁,*(j₁,!y_X(F))≅Rⁿp₂,*(j₂,!y_X(F)) in I(Y). The square identifying the open copies of X need not be Cartesian.

theorem zlIndWeilProperOpenHigher
    {X₀ Z₁ Z₂ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₁.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₁.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₂.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₂.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (j₁ : X₀ ⟶ Z₁) (j₂ : X₀ ⟶ Z₂)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₁.left] [IsOpenImmersion j₂.left]
    (p₁ : Z₁ ⟶ Y₀) (p₂ : Z₂ ⟶ Y₀)
    [IsProper p₁.left] [IsProper p₂.left]
    (r : Z₁ ⟶ Z₂) [IsProper r.left]
    (_hi : j₁ ≫ r = j₂) (_hp : r ≫ p₂ = p₁)
    (n : ℕ) (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω) :
    Nonempty
      (((zlIndWeilPush D l hl Ω p₁).rightDerived n).obj
          ((zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₁).obj
            ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj F)) ≅
        ((zlIndWeilPush D l hl Ω p₂).rightDerived n).obj
          ((zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₂).obj
            ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj F)))
